levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن رزمة القزويني

notes: أبي علي بن الحسين: أبي + name is one link, its surface the name alone (rule 7).
وهو آخذ بشعره is a description, not a link; the footnote markers (2) and (3) and the blessings are left out.
The Prophet is the end of the chain (rule 12); Ali is the last link.
